summary: First-party executable plugin contributing separate Volcengine ModelArk and Volcengine Speech Providers.
context_hints: The plugin id is clash.volcengine; its Provider ids are volcengine and volcengine-speech
Each Provider has independent accounts; the Host exposes only the selected account's apiKey/baseUrl through context.store
Provider request translation, submission, and polling stay inside this plugin
Seedance uses the ModelArk executor and Bearer credentials; Seed Audio uses the OpenSpeech executor and X-Api-Key credentials

subdirectories.providers: Independent ModelArk and Volcengine Speech Provider declarations and authentication forms.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint plus separate ModelArk and OpenSpeech executors.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations.
key_files.providers/volcengine.json: ModelArk Provider metadata plus API-key and overrideable Base URL fields.
key_files.providers/volcengine-speech.json: OpenSpeech Provider metadata plus its independent API-key and Base URL fields.
key_files.src/modelark.ts: Seedance request translation and asynchronous submit/poll lifecycle.
key_files.src/speech.ts: Seed Audio request translation and synchronous OpenSpeech lifecycle.
